$Comment: What a member of the Warden fight sees as the Warden sheds its bark and moves into its next
phase: one red line in the notice feed. The Warden's binding row points its PhaseChanged beat
here (Feedback.PhaseChanged), so the words belong to this fight alone.
The moment fires once per live member at each phase and carries 'phase' (the script's state
name, Phase_2 or Phase_3) should a line want to name it; this one keeps the same words for both
changes on purpose, since the fight speaks for itself. Add a Sound for a roar.
